method: Independent read-only source and regression-test review of the shared working tree; no tests, Flutter/Dart/pub/native commands, live queries, mutations, deployment, code generation, or git writes executed.

findings.title: An unrelated create-recovery error silently prevents existing visitor edits
findings.evidenceType: Source-confirmed control-flow defect; runtime reproduction intentionally not executed under review constraints
trigger: Open Add Visitor and encounter a durable intent read failure or an existing-request receipt query failure, so VisitorProvider.createRecoveryError is non-null.
Leave Add without successfully reconciling the error, open a previously existing editable preregistration, and choose Edit.
Modify valid fields and press the enabled Save button.
findings.actual: _save returns before state.save/update because createRecoveryError is checked without restricting the guard to create mode. Edit initialization intentionally skips reconcileCreate, the recovery error/retry controls are only rendered for create mode, and the enabled-button check already scopes this error to create mode. Therefore no update request occurs and the edit screen gives no explanation or local recovery action.
findings.impact: A transient failure of the new creation-recovery path disables editing unrelated existing invitations for the same session until the user first recovers through Add or changes session.

supportingSources.explanation: Reconciliation failure persists createRecoveryError in provider state.
Edit mode skips reconciliation, so opening Edit does not clear that prior create error.
Recovery error and retry action are shown only in create mode.
The edit Save button remains enabled because its createRecoveryError gate is correctly restricted to create mode.
The provider update branch itself is independent of create recovery and would allow the valid edit.

findings.suggestedFix: In _save, restrict createRecoveryLoading/createRecoveryError gating to widget.visitor == null and keep the local preparation gate as needed. Keep the create-side fail-closed behavior unchanged.
findings.suggestedRegression: Cause create reconciliation to fail, leave Add, open Edit on a valid existing visitor, press Save, and assert exactly one update and no create/claim/receipt retry. Confirm that Add remains blocked until its recovery error is resolved.
findings.resolution: Open when reviewed; source/test fixes are owned by coordinator/writers.

coverage.area: HomeScreen and DoorOperationRecoveryDialog, door provider/repository/model/store and regression tests
coverage.result: No additional confirmed P1/P2 issue. Recovery is reachable without a Home status card; checks are read-only, explicit retry queries before sending, and its provider uses the persisted requestId/deviceId/doorId. Pending/sent/unknown stay unresolved; known receipts are not requeued. Session epoch/token guards hide old state and reject old-dialog actions. Command confirmation text remains separate from physical passage/attendance.

No confirmed P1/P2 issue. Istanbul business-day comparison also covers new week/month; the period advances before requests and post-frame checks coalesce resume/visibility. Date/device filter state is preserved. Reviewed hidden-branch, day/month/week rollover, same-day, overlay and disposal cases.

No confirmed P1/P2 issue. projectName is optional for older mobile DTOs, type-checked when present, and shown only with projectId. Missing/deleted project safely returns null/unavailable. Backend reads employees.projectId directly and does not join or copy the same-email web account. AuthProvider replaces/clears currentUser across login/logout; profile reads current user rather than retaining project state.

coverage.area: Visitor durable create recovery, receipt authorization and form gates
coverage.result: CORE-01. No confirmed duplicate-prevention or identity-leakage defect in the reviewed paths. Disk intent contains only scoped identifiers and uses serialized claim and matching-ID removal. Null receipt retains the identifier; explicit replay uses that identifier and backend fingerprint conflict prevents changed payload from creating a second visitor. Scope/epoch/session checks reject late reads, claims and receipts after account changes. Receipt returns only id/status and validates employee host/project ownership. New auth-expiry and delayed-claim tests were also inspected after they appeared in the shared tree.

coverage.area: Visitor modal detail lifecycle and shell hooks
coverage.result: No confirmed P1/P2 issue. Detail polling ownership is independent of covered list visibility and shares a single timer. Foreground false cancels the timer and invalidates in-flight read request generations; resume refreshes retained detail. Close/session reset/dispose clear detail ownership. Root modal continues to cover bottom navigation.
